entries.name: NVIDIA Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3
entries.description: The built-in engine. 25 European languages, punctuation + casing, word timestamps; the only model with a Qualcomm NPU path.

measurements.machine: ASUS Zenbook A16 - Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme X2E94100, 48 GB, Windows 11 build 28000 ARM64
measurements.source: docs/benchmarks.md 5.1 - `lw bench tests/fixtures/audio --backend cpu`, 12 FLEURS clips, 2026-08-27

measurements.machine: ASUS Zenbook A16 - Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme X2E94100, 48 GB, Windows 11 build 28000 ARM64
measurements.source: docs/benchmarks.md 5.1 - `lw bench tests/fixtures/audio --backend npu`, encoder on Hexagon HTP V81, 12 FLEURS clips, 2026-08-26

entries.notes: MEASURED on this project's target machine (Snapdragon X2 Elite X2E94100): end-to-end RTF 0.032 on the CPU EP and 0.0145 with the encoder on the Hexagon HTP V81, word-weighted WER 5.4% / 4.8% over 12 FLEURS clips - see docs/benchmarks.md 5.1. The per-language wer_estimates come from the same run with only 3 clips per language, so treat them as indicative, not statistically meaningful; the English figure is dominated by FLEURS number-word and casing normalisation ('2' vs 'two'), not misrecognition. download_bytes/disk_bytes are the exact pinned file sizes in models/manifests/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3.json and cover the CPU int8 artifact set, which is the only hash-pinned target today. The NPU path additionally needs a static-shape encoder and builds a ~1.2 GB HTP context binary locally on first use (~106 s, cached thereafter) - that is generated on the machine, not downloaded, and is not counted in disk_bytes.

entries.name: Whisper tiny.en (sherpa-onnx export)
entries.description: English-only 39M-parameter Whisper. The smallest useful fallback; ships fp32 and int8 encoder/decoder ONNX.
entries.notes: VERIFIED: download_bytes is the real size of sherpa-onnx-whisper-tiny.en.tar.bz2 as reported by the GitHub release API for k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx tag asr-models (asset published 2024-07-13); the 39M parameter count is from the official openai/whisper README. NOT VERIFIED: no SHA-256 is published for that asset and we have not hashed it, so this entry has NO pinned manifest and `lw models install` will refuse it - a manifest is added once the file set is downloaded, hashed and pinned. disk_bytes is left empty: the k2-fsa docs list the decompressed ONNX files as roughly 36 MB + 185 MB (fp32) and 12 MB + 105 MB (int8), i.e. ~340 MB, but those are rounded doc figures, not a measurement. NO speed or accuracy number here was measured on any machine - the tiers are editorial and the RTF shown by `lw models list` is an estimate. Needs the not-yet-default `sherpa` engine feature.

entries.name: Whisper base (sherpa-onnx export)
entries.description: Multilingual 74M-parameter Whisper. Covers 99 languages at modest accuracy; a reasonable CPU-only fallback where Parakeet has no language coverage.
entries.notes: VERIFIED: download_bytes is the real size of sherpa-onnx-whisper-base.tar.bz2 from the GitHub release API for k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx tag asr-models (asset published 2024-10-02); the 74M parameter count and the 99-language list are taken from the official openai/whisper README and whisper/tokenizer.py LANGUAGES, minus 'yue' (Cantonese), which that table only wires up for large-v3. NOT VERIFIED: no published SHA-256, so no pinned manifest and no install; disk_bytes unknown. Whisper accuracy varies enormously by language and the openai/whisper README publishes per-size WER for no size at all, so wer_estimates is deliberately empty rather than filled with plausible-looking numbers. Quality/speed tiers are editorial; the RTF shown is an estimate, never measured here. Needs the `sherpa` engine feature.

entries.name: Whisper small (sherpa-onnx export)
entries.description: Multilingual 244M-parameter Whisper. The accuracy step up from base, at roughly 3x the compute; still CPU-only here.
entries.notes: VERIFIED: download_bytes is the real size of sherpa-onnx-whisper-small.tar.bz2 from the GitHub release API for k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx tag asr-models (asset published 2024-07-13); the 244M parameter count and the 99-language list come from openai/whisper (tokenizer.py LANGUAGES minus 'yue', which is large-v3 only). NOT VERIFIED: no published SHA-256, therefore no pinned manifest and no install; disk_bytes unknown; no WER pinned. The openai/whisper README's relative-speed column puts small at roughly 4x realtime versus tiny at 10x, which is why the speed tier drops two steps - that ordering is published, the RTF number this CLI shows is still only an estimate. Needs the `sherpa` engine feature.

entries.name: Moonshine tiny en (int8, sherpa-onnx export)
entries.description: English-only streaming-friendly ASR designed for short utterances on small devices; int8 ONNX, no fixed 30 s padding.
entries.notes: VERIFIED: download_bytes is the real size of sherpa-onnx-moonshine-tiny-en-int8.tar.bz2 from the GitHub release API for k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx tag asr-models (asset published 2024-10-26); the MIT licence is stated in the moonshine-ai/moonshine README. NOT VERIFIED: no published SHA-256, so no pinned manifest and no install; disk_bytes unknown. Moonshine publishes WER comparisons against Whisper tiny/base, but we could not retrieve the exact table, so wer_estimates is left empty rather than quoted from memory. Nothing about this entry has been run on this machine. Needs the `sherpa` engine feature.
